However, the test failure indicates that the inversion operation is not producing the correct sparse array with the appropriate fill value and data type. To fix this issue, you should review the implementation of the inversion operation for sparse arrays in pandas. Specifically, ensure that the inversion correctly propagates the fill value and updates the data type to Sparse[bool, not fill_value] when applying the inversion operator (~).
